execution: Model read the local English skill and relevant supporting files; no client installation and no web browsing.

cases.prompt: I am starting a semiconductor master’s degree and expect to graduate in June 2029. I am based in Germany and want a digital verification job in Germany or the Netherlands. I can spend 6 hours a week outside my thesis. I know basic Verilog and Python but have no commercial EDA account or work experience. Please use the employer cases in this skill to explain what I need to learn. Can I apply to those jobs? Give me a first-week plan, a four-week direction, and a 60-minute action I can do today. Use only the supplied materials for now; do not search the web. Ask only for details you still need.
assertions: Respond in English and begin with the target role's capabilities before asking for missing information.
Preserve the June 2029 graduation date and distinguish 2027 graduate cohorts from NVIDIA's title-only year.
Do not present China-region cases as verified German or Dutch vacancies or currently open jobs.
Preserve Renesas expiry and SGMICRO's experienced-hire 3+ years condition.
Distinguish required, preferred, duties and teaching suggestions, including the two SVA contexts.
Schedule 4.8 hours plus a 1.2-hour buffer each week; include today's action in that budget.
Give concrete outputs, acceptance checks, a tool-unavailable fallback and realistic multieweek scope.
Do not assign proven skill levels from self-report or claim unexecuted RTL/commercial signoff evidence.
Separate deliberate educational fault injection from a real defect; accept truthful all-pass outcomes.
Ask only for missing research, tool and application constraints without repeating supplied facts.

limitations: A single forward-use case is a smoke test, not a success-rate estimate or proof of cross-client compatibility. Read the QA report for review and execution boundaries.
